title: Implementation of new US sanctions and tariff measures
rationale: Trump signs Russia sanctions bill into law; bill gives sweeping new tariff powers.

title: Attacks targeting nuclear and energy infrastructure
rationale: Drone hit cooling tower at Kursk nuclear plant; drones hit oil refinery in Moscow region.

title: Expansion of Russian asset seizures
rationale: Russia seizes Nestlé and Auchan operations; Putin targets Nestlé's Russian business.

title: Intensified Russian ballistic/long-range strikes
rationale: Russia adapts training missile for ballistic onslaught; new air campaign seeks to destroy Ukrainian economy.

title: Continued large-scale Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian targets
rationale: Ukraine hits Moscow with ‘largest ever’ drone attack; exchanges of major drone attacks reported.

title: Delivery and deployment of US air-defence upgrades to Ukraine
rationale: U.S. approves and clears way for $2.7 billion air-defense sale to Ukraine.

title: Far-right gains and Kremlin outreach affecting Western unity
rationale: AfD surge in German states; Putin envoy prepares talks with AfD to restore gas ties.

title: Western industrial ramp-up for air-defence and missile parts
rationale: GM to produce Patriot missile parts; calls to hurry to catch up with Ukraine on AI combat.

title: Increased DPRK–Russia military-industrial cooperation
rationale: North Korea sends women to Russian factories in line of Ukrainian fire; fires ballistic missile offshore.

title: Poland-Ukraine anti-ballistic coalition operations
rationale: Poland joins anti-ballistic missile coalition with Ukraine, signalling joint air-defence measures.

title: EU expansion of counter-drone detection and defenses
rationale: Luxembourg launches investigation after drones suspend flights; deploys additional detection assets.
